title: Inquest into death of man who died in police custody starts
article: A public inquest into the death of Desmond Roberts began Monday at the La Ronge Court House.
On May 31, 2015, the 43-year-old was found unresponsive in his cell at the La Ronge RCMP detachment.
Roberts was taken to hospital in La Ronge and then transferred to Royal University Hospital in Saskatoon, where he died.
The purpose of an inquest is to determine the circumstances surrounding the death.
The coroner's jury can also make recommendations to prevent further deaths.
The inquest is scheduled until Friday.
